entries.name: Spider
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Quaternius 2019), realistic tarantula anatomy

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Plan row 55 names the spider from Quaternius's Animated Creatures/Dinosaurs pack on poly.pizza (clips Spider_Attack, Spider_Death, Spider_Idle, Spider_Jump); poly.pizza is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so it comes from the same author's Easy Animated Enemy Pack (Jan 2019) on itch.io, which carries those clips plus Spider_Walk. The itch page states CC0; the zip ships no licence file. It is a realistic spider, not a giant monster: tarantula anatomy (eight eyes, chelicerae, pedipalps, bulky abdomen) at natural proportions, so the height is real size: 0.05 m at rest, a leg span of about 15 cm, a large tarantula. Scale it up in a film if it should be a monster. Colours on the noon script: brown body #5c3d32 with near-black shade (threshold 0 so the shade sits on the underside and leg undersides only), accent-red eyes. Ground: every clip is clamped (Spider_Walk and the flip onto the back in Spider_Death sink a leg tip 1 mm; the rest never sink).
